provider_notes: Mock supports authored key-value fixtures and narrow add-workstation/rename prompts only. Natural-language technical specs and all broader follow-ups require an explicitly selected live provider. Review every change set before accepting. Ordinary edits and exports use no model calls.

prompts.prompt: Rename Portal web service to Employee self-service portal
prompts.expected: Preview one component rename; preserve its ID, interfaces and manually adjusted placements.
Mock adds one unzoned workstation; explicitly review and assign its deployment to Client. It must not silently assume a trust zone.

prompts.prompt: Add a reporting service to Z1 and connect it to Request database over PostgreSQL TCP 5432 through Zone firewall. Keep all existing positions and routes.
prompts.expected: Review a targeted new service/deployment/interface proposal. Database zone stays Z2 and existing manual placements remain.

prompts.prompt: Make Portal web service a pair of active-active instances, and make Zone firewall a pair of active-passive instances. Keep them hosted on Application hosts. Do not change Request database.
prompts.expected: Review quantity 2 and explicit redundancy changes only for those deployments. This does not by itself settle recovery targets or approve the architecture.
